kpiTooltip.shareOfVoice: Your overall brand presence across AI responses. Each mention of your brand or its product variants counts separately. If Nike Air Max and Nike Pegasus both appear in the same answer, that's 2 mentions.
kpiTooltip.visibility: How often your brand is named in AI responses, regardless of rank. Range 0–100%. 75% means your brand was cited in 75% of relevant questions across the selected AI engines.
kpiTooltip.avgPosition: Your typical rank when an AI engine lists brands. Lower is better. #1 means you are usually named first in the response.
kpiTooltip.winRate: Your win rate on head-to-head competitive questions. 100% means AI engines always pick your brand over the named competitors.
kpiTooltip.sentiment: Average tone of how AI engines describe your brand, scored –100 (negative) to +100 (positive).

citationTooltip.favorability: Whether this domain is cited in answers where your brand wins or loses. Favorable = AI picks or names you when it cites this domain. Unfavorable = AI picks competitors or criticizes you when this domain comes up.
citationTooltip.citationSignals: Three ways this domain may be hurting your brand presence: visibility gaps (questions where you weren't named), competitive losses (head-to-head questions you lost), and topics with negative sentiment. Each signal lists the specific questions or topics so you know what to address.

reportHealth.empty: No reports found for this organisation
reportHealth.replayResult: Replayed: {{replayed}} · Already claimed: {{claimed}} — the pipeline updates automatically

confirm.title: Run pipeline stage
confirm.description: This will replay {{triggers}} for "{{entity}}" — the same safe path as the watchdog (claimed exactly-once, no duplicate LLM spend). Type REPLAY to confirm.

enrichment.title: Enrichment replay (brand grouping)
enrichment.hint: Recomputes the stored enrichment of one snapshot — brand grouping, concepts, sentiment. Irreversible and not deterministic (re-calls the AI brand matcher): replay only snapshots enriched before a grouping fix, a healthy snapshot can get worse. One snapshot at a time — the full-history replay is a runbook operation.
enrichment.timeoutNote: This can take a few minutes. If the request times out, the replay still completes server-side — check the dashboard, do not replay again.
enrichment.error: Enrichment replay failed — check backend logs

confirm.title: Replay enrichment
confirm.descriptionOne: This recomputes the stored enrichment of snapshot {{snapshot}}… — brand grouping, concepts and sentiment may change, and there is no undo. Type REPLAY to confirm.

enrichment.snapshotsError: Could not load the snapshots of this report — retry by reselecting it
enrichment.notTerminal: Report is {{status}} — the pipeline is writing it. Replay once the run has completed.
enrichment.timedOut: The request ended without a response (timeout). The replay most likely finished server-side — check the dashboard before doing anything else, and do NOT replay again.
